material.title: Acme Foods moves its global media account to a new agency after a six-month review
material.bodyOriginal: Acme Foods today said it has appointed Example Media as its global media agency of record across 40 markets, following a six-month review. The account was previously handled by another holding company. The transition will begin in January.
